rationale.conceptual: The algorithm is a custom research-grade method with several interacting components (multisite lattice, RF interaction model, BOC barrier equations, variable‑step KMC). Correctly translating the paper’s equations and protocols into working code demands domain knowledge and attention to detail beyond a standard library call, but all parameters are provided and the method is explicitly described, placing it at a moderately high conceptual difficulty.

No external tooling, data fetching, or complex orchestration; only a few sequential steps and standard I/O are needed.
